name: A month of standing drops this morning's credential
non_visual_rationale: The gate firing is visible only as smaller integers inside a stored JSON record; there is no surface, and by design no user-visible consequence, because ineligible reports still appear on every display-instantly surface this slice does not touch. U1-U8 and a Vera walk are therefore N/A.
criteria: With thirty days of standing required, the mornings reported on the same-morning credential are gone from the count.
Only six people count toward the five that publication requires.
Ineligible samples leave the fit and every gated count, including the count inside the stored error's floor.
The gate is watched firing and not firing; the shipped no-op alone would prove nothing.
scope_note: The roadmap lists src/learning/estimate.ts among this step's files_to_modify, on the reading that the n inside se_gate's floor needs its own edit. No edit was required: 01-16 applies eligibility once to the whole log before it is grouped by spot, so the floor already receives the post-eligibility count. The acceptance pins that structurally by reading n back off the STORED record and asserting the floor at that count, and by asserting the floor is NOT the one for the raw 22-morning count.
acceptance: The nightly fit runs twice over the accepted 22-morning, 7-reporter fixture: once at the shipped settings (gate not firing) and once asking for 30 days of standing (gate firing). The oracle asserts 22/7 unfired and 18/6 fired, that six still clears G2's five so the drop shows in the counts rather than in a refusal, and that the stored error equals the physical floor at the count the record itself reports and not at 22. It rejects three controlled mutations: an unmoved morning count, an unmoved reporter count, and an error still floored at the raw count.
red_evidence: src/learning/trust.ts's age clause was inverted to always hold. Three tests failed semantically: the acceptance ('must remove the four mornings reported on the same-morning credential'), the firing unit law ('must drop exactly the credentials younger than that, and nobody else') and the fail-closed law. 01-16's shipped-config identity law PASSED under the same mutation, which is the concrete demonstration of 06 section 7's clause check:unfired-is-not-evidence: the no-op step alone could not have caught this. The mutation was reverted and `git diff --stat src/` confirmed empty before the gate was re-run.
